# Invoices & Time Tracker — Professional Invoice Maker for Freelancers & Contractors

> A free iOS invoice maker app that helps freelancers, contractors, and small businesses create professional invoices in under 30 seconds using voice commands, GPS time tracking, and AI-powered features. Privacy-first with on-device processing, no account required, and works completely offline.

By Das Group LLC (https://dasgroupllc.com/)

## Quick Summary
Invoices & Time Tracker is a privacy-first iOS app that revolutionizes freelancer invoicing by combining voice-based invoice creation, built-in time tracking with GPS geofencing, and AI-powered Smart Compose. Users can create professional PDF invoices in under 30 seconds directly from their iPhone. All data processing happens on-device - speech recognition, GPS tracking, and AI features run locally. No account, sign-up, or internet connection required.

## Key Features
- **Voice Invoice Creation**: Speak naturally to create invoices with AI parsing
- **Built-in Time Tracker**: One-tap start/stop with automatic invoice generation
- **GPS Job Sites**: Automatic time tracking via geofencing when arriving/leaving locations
- **AI Smart Compose**: Auto-detects clients, line items, rates, and quantities from voice or text
- **Professional PDF Export**: Custom branding, logos, and multiple invoice templates
- **Client Management**: Organize clients with custom rates and branding
- **Revenue Dashboard**: Track income, overdue invoices, and payment status
- **Offline Functionality**: Works without internet connection
- **Industry Templates**: Pre-built templates for consulting, construction, design, cleaning, legal, and more
- **Overdue Invoice Alerts**: Automatic reminders for unpaid invoices
- **Multiple Creation Flows**: Voice, AI text, quick entry, or detailed manual creation
- **Privacy-First**: All data stored on-device, no cloud sync required

## Target Audience
### Primary Users
- Freelancers: Web developers, graphic designers, copywriters, consultants, coaches, tutors, virtual assistants
- Independent Contractors: Construction workers, electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, handymen, cleaners, landscapers
- Small Business Owners: Service-based businesses, solopreneurs, micro-businesses
- Service Professionals: Lawyers, accountants, therapists, personal trainers, photographers, videographers

### Secondary Users
- Part-time workers with side gigs
- Gig economy workers (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash drivers with freelance work)
- Students doing freelance work
- Retirees with consulting businesses
- Anyone who bills clients for time or services

## Pricing & Availability
- **Free Plan**: Up to 5 clients, 3 watermark-free PDF exports, unlimited time tracking, voice & AI invoice creation, GPS job sites
- **Pro Plan**: Unlimited clients & exports, no watermarks, custom branding & logo, AI email composition, priority support
- **Availability**: Free to download on Apple App Store
- **Geographic Focus**: United States (primary), Canada, UK, Australia, New Zealand (secondary), worldwide (tertiary)

## Privacy & Security Features
- All data stored locally on your device
- On-device speech recognition (no audio sent to servers)
- Local GPS geofencing processing
- No accounts, no sign-up required
- No tracking or analytics collection
- No cloud sync (optional iCloud backup)
- End-to-end encryption for exported PDFs
- Privacy policy: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/privacy/

## Use Cases & Workflows
### Common Use Cases
1. **Voice Creation**: "Invoice for Sarah Chen, 12 hours of web development at $150 an hour, plus $500 for the logo design"
2. **GPS Time Tracking**: Automatically starts timer when arriving at client job site
3. **Quick Invoice**: Tap recent client, add hours, send PDF in seconds
4. **Batch Invoicing**: Combine multiple time entries into one invoice
5. **Offline Work**: Create invoices and track time without internet
6. **Professional Branding**: Add your logo, colors, and business information to PDFs

### Industry-Specific Workflows
- **Construction**: Track time at job sites, add material costs, create detailed invoices
- **Consulting**: Track billable hours, add project milestones, generate professional invoices
- **Design**: Track time per project, add revision rounds, create branded invoices
- **Cleaning**: Track time per location, add service details, create recurring invoices
- **Legal**: Track billable hours, add case details, create compliant invoices
